sample.freeze_rule: both forecasts frozen before nominal 19:00 Europe/Rome draw time

hypothesis.h100_primary: After controlling for equal-sized exclusive candidate slices per target, the positional-only Top20 candidates add more actual winning numbers than the global-only Top20 candidates.
hypothesis.paired_endpoint: sum(actual hits in positional Top20 minus global Top20) minus sum(actual hits in global Top20 minus positional Top20), equivalently sum(positional-only hits - global-only hits), paired by target.
hypothesis.null: Within each target, the two exclusive slices have equal size m=20-intersection_size; under exchangeability of candidate identities, swapping the two slices leaves the null distribution of their hit-count difference unchanged.
hypothesis.secondary_absolute_null: For each target t, the hit count in an m_t-number exclusive slice follows Hypergeometric(population=40, successes=m_t, draws=5); convolve target-specific discrete distributions.
hypothesis.future_confirmatory_cohort: Next 178 complete paired targets including any already frozen pre-target pair whose outcome is not yet known at registration; no retrospective backfill; engines and candidate lists unchanged.

family: H100 paired positional-only versus global-only hits

limitations: All 22 targets were already inspected in H97-H99; H100 is exploratory and cannot be treated as a fresh blind OOS result.
The candidate union contains 23-25 numbers, so raw union-hit totals must be compared with target-specific hypergeometric expectations; the size-adjusted test shows no excess.
No discovery/validation/blind split is claimed for H100 because this is a small fixed-engine prospective replay, not a newly fitted walk-forward model.
Q60's primary 5-of-5 promotion gate remains unchanged and still requires 200 complete paired targets.
next_action: Freeze both unchanged engines for each new target, evaluate only after canonical outcome publication, append outcomes without modifying forecasts, and run the registered 178-pair confirmatory complementarity analysis with the paired exclusive-hit endpoint primary and the size-adjusted hypergeometric endpoints secondary under Holm.
